data.gender_notes: Kulbhushan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Kul' and 'Bhusan'. 'Kul' refers to the god Kul and 'Bhusan' means adorned or ornamented with. This name is believed to bring the blessings of the god Kul, who is worshipped for his power and protection. The name Kulbhushan carries the meaning “Power of the God Kul” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kulbhushan usually hope their child will grow to embody power of the god kul and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kulbhushan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power of the God Kul.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kulbhushan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
